content.title: Partnership Overview
content.summary: Operating model, governance cadence, and partnership structure for sustained delivery.
narrative: The partnership model closes the ADM by translating the delivery architecture and roadmap into explicit governance, staffing, and execution rhythms.
Northstar's execution assumptions imply a weekly design authority cadence and a monthly architecture review rhythm during active modernization waves.

cards.title: Governance Cadence
cards.detail: Weekly design authority, monthly architecture review board

callouts: Holiday code freeze applies from mid-November through early January for customer-facing platforms.
Target delivery-mix shift to 55% offshore is achieved by year 3, with architecture and product ownership remaining onshore-led.
Architecture review board meets monthly and transformation design authority meets weekly during active modernization waves.
Wave 1 prioritizes customer identity, pricing, returns, and observability foundations before major order and supply-chain rewrites.
